svg.title: Which FlashSystem fits
svg.desc: The five FlashSystem models, what each is for and the most one enclosure holds: FlashSystem 5000, smaller mixed workloads and backup, up to 573 TBe; FlashSystem 5600, mixed workloads and smaller transaction databases, up to 2.4 PBe; FlashSystem 7600, larger mixed and transaction workloads, up to 7.2 PBe; FlashSystem 9600, consolidated mixed workloads and critical transaction databases, up to 11.8 PBe; FlashSystem C300, backup, sequential and archive workloads, up to 11.8 PBe.
